findings.why: "Suitable even for sensitive skin" is attached to the PHA ingredient but reads as a promise for the product on sensitive skin; the page gives it only as an ingredient note (F7), and the product-level evidence is just the patch-test statement (F20).
findings.fix: Describe the ingredient only, as the page does ("A hydroxy acid that exfoliates gently", F23), or keep the line only if sensitive-skin evidence for the product is on file.

tone_read: Educational and calm: it names each active, its strength and what it is, which is exactly Minimalist's ingredient-and-concentration-led voice. No fear, hype or result promises.
language_read: Strengths are stated exactly ("10%", "1%", "86% pure Vitamin C content" as on the page), and the purity line follows the brand's precise-grade practice. The headline's "10% Vitamin C" is the brand's own naming for a 10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid active, which the on-image line makes explicit.
